name: pt-commenter
description: A PT commenter agent built with @lifetimesoft/agent-sdk

env.name: mode
env.label: Operation Mode
env.description: Agent operation mode: normal, maintenance, or stats

env.name: feed_job_enable
env.label: Enable Feed Job
env.description: Enable or disable fetching new PT posts

env.name: comment_enable
env.label: Enable Comment Job
env.description: Enable or disable commenting on posts

env.name: max_tasks_per_run
env.label: Max Tasks Per Run
env.description: Maximum number of tasks to process per scheduler run. Remaining tasks are picked up on the next run.

env.name: min_wait_minutes
env.label: Minimum Wait Time (minutes)
env.description: Minimum wait time between operations in minutes

env.name: max_wait_minutes
env.label: Maximum Wait Time (minutes)
env.description: Maximum wait time between operations in minutes
